author: ClubberNugget
body:
Name: Assault

Map creators: Random_Guy

Gamemode: Destroy the Orb

                Type: Attackers vs. Defenders


Here is a map for the potential game mode, destroy the orb, I cannot make a YML for it until Avicus docs has it, but until then, the devs can use this map if they’d like to test the gamemode in general.  I want this gamemode to happen so I made this map to give the gamemode more of a selection of maps in the beginning.

Thanks for reading and all feedback is appreciated^_^

Album

I put this in map making because I cannot finish it yet.
